description: This file defines the AzureTableTransactionalStateStorageFactory class, which implements factory and lifecycle participant interfaces for creating and managing Azure Table Storage-based transactional state storage within Orleans. It includes methods for creating storage instances, initializing Azure Table, and participating in silo lifecycle events.

classes.name: AzureTableTransactionalStateStorageFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Azure Table Storage-based transactional state storage instances and managing their lifecycle within Orleans.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of AzureTableTransactionalStateStorageFactory using dependency injection and options monitor.

methods.name: AzureTableTransactionalStateStorageFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with configuration options, cluster options, services, and logger factory.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new transactional state storage instance for a given grain state type and context.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the factory to the silo lifecycle to initialize resources at a specified stage.

methods.name: MakePartitionKey
methods.description: Generates a partition key for Azure Table Storage based on grain context and state name.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Initializes the Azure Table by creating or ensuring the table exists.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Lifecycle method that triggers table creation during silo startup.
